name: Xia Ri Shuiguo Tang
source:
A Yuri interactive visual novel about "Day and Night Out of Sync." Two girls, living in different rhythms, exchange hearts through letters and fruit candies. A poignant summer tale of youth and hidden feelings.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4327610/]Steam[/url]]
